<cfcomponent>
    <cffunction name="render" returntype="void">
        <cfargument name="styles" type="struct" required="yes">
        <style type="text/css">
            <cfoutput>
            .listing {color:#arguments.styles.color#;
                font-size:<cfif arguments.styles.size EQ 'small'>smaller<cfelse>medium</cfif>;}
        </style>
        <table class="listing" bgcolor="#arguments.styles.bgcolor#">
            <tr>
                <td>x</td>
            </tr>
        </table>
        </cfoutput>
    </cffunction>
</cfcomponent>
